title: Knowledge graph L2-DMN: DMN Input Clause
description: An input column. Its expression text is where data element names are embedded, which is the only reason this is a node rather than a property of the table. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/dmn-input-clause.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for KGDmnInputClause logical model

id.description: The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).

expression.description: The input expression (FEEL or the DAK's convention).

ordinal.description: Position, counted from 0, in the order the source lists it.
